plan.name: v1.9.4-bridge-attestor-fix
plan.info: Store all attestors separately to fix gas variance

title: Upgrade: v1.9.4-bridge-attestor-fix
summary:
This upgrade stores all bridge attestors in separate KV entries so attestation records remain fixed-size.

Problem:
- Attestors were stored as growing maps inside attestation records
- When multiple validators attest in the same block, the map grows between simulation and execution
- This caused unpredictable gas usage and out-of-gas failures

Changes:
- New store prefix: bridge_mint_attestors/{chain}/{burn_id}/{valoper} (outbound)
- New store prefix: bridge_attestors/{chain}/{burn_id}/{valoper} (inbound)
- Attestation records now fixed-size regardless of attestor count
- Orchestrator retry ladder: 1.5x → 2x → 2.5x → 3x → 5x

Note: This replaces v1.9.3-bridge-fee-burn which passed governance but didn't execute.

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to v1.9.4 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
